name: Aws Startup Advisor
description: Personalized architecture, cost, security, and migration guidance for startups. From day-one account setup and security baselines to production-ready infrastructure, cost optimization, and beyond. Includes AWS Activate Credits eligibility, 60+ exclusive startup offers, and multi-account multi-region support. Built on expertise from AWS Startup Solutions Architects and patterns from 350,000+ startups.
longDescription:
Ships **9 skills**, **6 agents**, **1 hook** and **4 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (9): `agent-advisor` (Unified entry point for AI-agent work on AWS: evaluate and pick a runtime, generate a full migration plan…), `architect-for-startups` (Startup-tailored AWS architecture advice that adjusts recommendations to the company's stage (pre-revenue through Series B+), team size, runway,…), `gcp-to-aws` (Migrate workloads from Google Cloud Platform to AWS — including AI and agentic workloads regardless of cloud provider), `heroku-to-aws` (Migrate workloads from Heroku to AWS), `knowledge-base-for-startups` (AWS Startups reference content — Activate FAQ, credits guide, programs, partner offers, sample architectures, and hundreds of learn…), `llm-to-bedrock` (Use when the user wants to migrate code that calls OpenAI, Gemini/Google AI, or the Anthropic API to…), `prompt-library-for-startups` (AWS-curated copy-paste prompts for AI coding agents (MVP scaffolding, RAG chatbot with Claude on Bedrock, security baseline evaluation,…), `start-building-for-startups` (Interactive discovery + implementation workflow that gathers requirements through picker-based questions (intent, scope, constraints, preferences), scans the codebase…), and 1 more
- **Agents** (6): `generic-phase-worker-rw` (Generic, phase-AGNOSTIC worker that runs ONE migration phase's work (its fragments + assembler) in an isolated context and…), `llm2bedrock-code-analyzer` (Analyze the local source repo, detect the AI framework and LLM SDK usage, map all call sites, identify…), `llm2bedrock-code-rewriter` (Rewrite LLM SDK calls to Amazon Bedrock on a dedicated git branch, swap dependencies, generate tests, and apply…), `llm2bedrock-log-ingestor` (Parse LLM API logs from the local repo, extract prompt/response pairs, and build a golden dataset (prompts.jsonl) for…), `llm2bedrock-prompt-evaluator` (Run each golden prompt against the target Bedrock model via the pinned uv harness, score with LLM-as-judge, and…), `llm2bedrock-report-generator` (Synthesize all prior phase results into a final Markdown migration report — model mapping, eval scores, code diffs,…)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (4): `awsknowledge`, `awspricing`, `temporal-docs`, `aws-pricing-calculator`

Installs with `claude plugin install aws-startup-advisor@claude-plugins-official` from `awslabs/startups` (`advisor/plugins/aws-startup-advisor`).
